name: nuke-control
description: Control local Nuke, execute Python, and inspect scene dependencies. Includes numeric animation keys, native graph import/export and project format/FPS.

interface.shortDescription: Nuke 脚本执行与场景检查
interface.longDescription: Install the Nuke 15.1 bridge with your permission, connect automatically after Nuke restarts, inspect scene resources, and run requested Python scripts. Structured tools support numeric animation keys, native graph import/export and project format/FPS; multi-instance writes use explicit targets and guards.
